purpose: Replace the undersized extracted master crop with a responsive composition assembled from the approved source parts at their native pixel densities.
composition: HTML and CSS position the original tactile boat and storefront around approved transparent physical display composites. The folded Duo keeps its distinct physical silhouette with a CSS clip around only its device form. The original Master Design Mockup remains preserved in hero-reference.json; no bitmap upscaling or generated customer imagery is used.

delivery.desktop: 1395px browser, 1298px folded-Duo, 720px storefront, and 800px boat candidates cover the rendered desktop scene at 2x.
delivery.mobile: At a 430px 3x phone, the browser selects 900px, the Duo selects 720px, and both scenery pieces select 480px candidates without upscaling.
delivery.encoding: Deterministic cwebp delivery encodes only; source artwork is preserved unchanged. Desktop display and scenery variants use visually checked lossy delivery, with smaller phone candidates selected only when their native pixels cover the rendered area.
